purpose: Pickup highlight concepts; no gameplay code changes

variants.name: Тонкий контур
variants.design: Selection treatment: a very thin continuous warm ivory contour tracing the actual outer silhouette of the tankard and its handle, subtle inner edge emphasis and almost no glow. A tiny quiet four-stroke aiming cross rests on the object. Matching bottom prompt: unboxed ivory text, small ivory right-mouse glyph, a short faint horizontal divider. This is the cleanest and most understated option.
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished raster GAME INTERACTION HIGHLIGHT CONCEPT AND MATCHING UI ASSET for Eclipse Roleplay, a grounded medieval Minecraft roleplay server.
Output: one square 1024x1024 PNG with a genuinely transparent alpha background.
Layout: the upper 70 percent shows a single small voxel wooden tankard with iron bands and a handle on the right, viewed at a three-quarter angle, clearly a custom Minecraft item with chunky pixel textures, centered and large. Surround ONLY this tankard with the specified hover/selection highlight. The lower 25 percent shows the matching isolated 2D interaction prompt asset, separated from the example by ample empty transparent space. This lower asset must contain a simple right-mouse-button glyph and the exact Ukrainian word "ВЗЯТИ", clean and legible. Do not put the tankard into the lower asset.
Style: restrained, readable at actual game HUD size, subtle handmade medieval craftsmanship, warm bone ivory and aged brass against transparency. Thin crisp purposeful shapes. The highlight must not hide the object's materials or silhouette. A premium coherent game interface, not a fantasy painting.
Constraints: no scene background, no opaque panels spanning the canvas, no checkerboard pattern baked into the pixels, no title, no variant name, no explanatory labels, no watermark, no hands, no characters, no extra objects, no health bars, no full inventory, no sci-fi holograms, no neon colors, no excessive bloom, no visual clutter. Only the demonstrated tankard, its selection treatment, and the separate matching interaction prompt. Exact text only: "ВЗЯТИ".
Selection treatment: a very thin continuous warm ivory contour tracing the actual outer silhouette of the tankard and its handle, subtle inner edge emphasis and almost no glow. A tiny quiet four-stroke aiming cross rests on the object. Matching bottom prompt: unboxed ivory text, small ivory right-mouse glyph, a short faint horizontal divider. This is the cleanest and most understated option.

variants.name: Латунні скоби
variants.design: Selection treatment: four separate short angular aged-brass corner brackets close around the tankard bounds, disconnected sides and open middle, very small diamond accent at bottom center, no silhouette outline and no ring. Thin precision linework with a modest dark edge for contrast. Matching bottom prompt: compact dark-brown translucent slim strip, tiny brass corner caps, brass mouse glyph, warm ivory text. Grounded tool-like design.

variants.design: Selection treatment: sparse hand-drawn off-white chalk strokes echo parts of the tankard silhouette, a loose incomplete flattened chalk oval beneath the tankard, slight natural dry-chalk texture, intentionally restrained and asymmetrical, no sparkles. Matching bottom prompt: ivory mouse glyph and readable serif Ukrainian text with a thin broken chalk underline, transparent background, no panel. Medieval workshop sketch aesthetic.

variants.name: Знак долоні
variants.design: Selection treatment: a small aged-brass circular medallion containing a clear open-palm pictogram floats just to the lower right of the tankard and connects to it with a very short fine line; only a few subtle warm edge glints on the object. The medallion is small, the object remains dominant. Matching bottom prompt: a refined narrow charcoal translucent plaque with softly clipped corners, a tiny hand emblem at the left, right-mouse glyph, ivory Ukrainian text and a restrained brass hairline. Medieval seal and instrument craft, minimal ornament.

variants.name: Фокус астролябії
variants.design: Selection treatment: two very thin incomplete aged-gold orbital arcs framing the tankard, four sparse calibration ticks, a tiny crescent and at most three small dots. The center remains completely open, no filled disk, no runes, no glowing magic circle. It should suggest an old brass astrolabe and match a restrained astronomical medieval HUD. Matching bottom prompt: ivory Ukrainian text and mouse glyph between two very short brass arcs and a tiny centered diamond below, transparent background, no large plaque.
